summary: The root مَثَلٌ (mathal) signifies a description through comparison, often used for important or remarkable states.
lane: مَثَلٌ ذ i. q. صِفَةٌ [as meaning A description, condition, state, case, &c.]; (S, K, &c.;) or وَصْفٌ [meaning the same]: (Msb:) or this is a mistake: (Mbr, AAF, TA:) or it may be a tropical signification: (MF, TA:) for in the language of the Arabs it means a description by way of comparison: (AAF, TA:) you say مثل زيد مثل فلان [ The description of Zeyd, by way of comparison, or the condition, &c., is that of such a one ]: it is from المِثاَلُ and الحَذْوُ : (Mbr, TA:) it is metaphorically applied to a condition, state, or case, that is important, strange, or wonderful. (Ksh, Bd in ii. 16.) The phrase here given is more literally, and better, rendered, The similitude of Zeyd is the similitude, or is that, of such a one; for a similitude is a description by way of comparison. -b2- You say also, جَعَلَهُ مَثَلًا لِكَذَا [ He made it (an expression or the like) to be descriptive, by way of comparison, of such a thing ]. (TA passim.) [And مَثَلٌ لِكَذَا means An expression denoting, by way of similitude, such a thing. ] -b3- عَلَى المَثَلِ As indicative of resemblance to something. -b4- See بَدَلٌ .

parts.t: : see a verse of Kutheiyir in art.

headwords.gloss: He set it up; He set up

parts.t: a butt or mark: see an ex. voce

headwords.def: أَمْثَلَهُ He set it up: from مَثَلَ “ he stood erect. ” He set up a butt or mark: see an ex. voce غَرَضٌ .

headwords.gloss: He affected to be like, or imitated, such a thing; i. q; He used

parts.t: He affected to be like, or imitated, such a thing;
applied, the verse as a proverb,

headwords.def: تَمَثَّلَ بِكَذَا [ He affected to be like, or imitated, such a thing; ] i. q. تَشَبَّهَ بِهِ . (TA, art. شبه .) تَمَثَّلَ البَيْتَ and [more commonly] بِالبَيْتِ He used, or applied, the verse as a proverb, or proverbially. (MA.) See تَشَبَّهَ .

headwords.gloss: He became nearly in a sound; healthy, state; near to convalescence

parts.t: He became nearly in a sound,
he became more like the sound,
unhealthy, who is suffering from a chronic and pervading disease;
. (M.) Said also of a wound: (T, S in art.

headwords.def: تَمَاثَلَ He became nearly in a sound, or healthy, state; or near to convalescence: (K:) or he became more like the sound, or healthy, than the unsound, or unhealthy, who is suffering from a chronic and pervading disease; (TA;) or so تماثل لِلْبُرْءِ . (M.) Said also of a wound: (T, S in art. دمل :) and of a disease; like أَشْكَلَ . (TA, art. شكل .) تَمَاثَلَا i. q. تَشَابَهَا . (M, K in art. سوى .)

headwords.gloss: He followed his command, order, bidding; injunction; did like as he commanded, ordered, &c; he obeyed his command, order, &c

parts.t: He followed his command, order, bidding,
injunction; did like as he commanded, ordered, &c.;

headwords.def: اِمْتَثَلَ أَمْرَهُ He followed his command, order, bidding, or injunction; did like as he commanded, ordered, &c.; (Mgh;) he obeyed his command, order, &c. (Msb.)

headwords.gloss: A like; a similar person; thing; match; fellow; an analogue; A likeness, resemblance

parts.t: , used as a denotative of state, means
See an ex. in the Kur li. 23; and another, from Sakhr-el-Gheí, voce

headwords.def: مِثْلٌ A like; a similar person or thing; match; fellow; an analogue. (K, &c.) See نِدٌّ and voce بَدَلٌ . A likeness, resemblance, or semblance; see شَبَهٌ . An equivalent; a requital. مِثْلَ , used as a denotative of state, means Like. Ex. مَرَّ مِثْلَ البَرْقِ He passed like the lightning. See an ex. in the Kur li. 23; and another, from Sakhr-el-Gheí, voce فَرْضٌ .

headwords.gloss: Quality, made, manner, fashion; form; a model according to which another thing is made or proportioned; a pattern

parts.t: a model according to which another thing is made or proportioned; a pattern,
by which a thing is measured, proportioned, or cut out:
Without there having been any precedent

headwords.def: مِثَالٌ Quality, made, manner, fashion, and form; (Msb;) a model according to which another thing is made or proportioned; a pattern, ( مِقْدَارٌ ) by which a thing is measured, proportioned, or cut out: (T:) an example of a class of words, of a rule, &c. مِنْ غَيْرِ سَبْقِ مِثاَلٍ [ Without there having been any precedent ]. (Msb in art. قرح , &c.) [ A bed: ] بَناَتُ المِثَالِ The daughters of the bed; meaning women. (T in art. بنى .)
